description: Unit tests for internationalization translation prompts, including timeout handling, environment variable overrides, error decoration, and command resolution functions.

classes.name: fakePromptRunner
classes.description: A fake implementation of a prompt runner used for testing prompt interactions.

methods.name: FakePromptRunner.Prompt
methods.description: Executes the provided prompt function with the given context and message.

methods.name: FakePromptRunner.Stderr
methods.description: Returns the standard error string captured during prompt execution.

methods.name: TestRunPromptAddsTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that runPrompt adds a timeout to the context and correctly processes the prompt response.

methods.name: TestDocsI18nPromptTimeoutUsesEnvOverride
methods.description: Checks that the docsI18nPromptTimeout function respects the environment override.

methods.name: TestIsRetryableTranslateErrorRejectsDeadlineExceeded
methods.description: Ensures that a context deadline exceeded error is not considered retryable.

methods.name: TestIsRetryableTranslateErrorRejectsAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Ensures that authentication failure errors are not considered retryable.

methods.name: TestRunPromptIncludesStderr
methods.description: Verifies error wrapping includes stderr content when runPrompt fails.

methods.name: TestDecoratePromptErrorLeavesCleanErrorsAlone
methods.description: Checks that decorating a clean error does not alter it.

methods.name: TestResolveDocsPiCommandUsesOverrideEnv
methods.description: Verifies env variables override command resolution for Docs Pi.

methods.name: TestShouldMaterializePiRuntimeForPiMonoWrapper
methods.description: Tests whether a Pi mono wrapper triggers runtime materialization based on directory structure and symlinks.
